status: Revision-stage specification, recorded after historical estimates and audit, before revision results; not a retrospective preregistration.
baseline_status: Recovered panel and early estimator reconciled; final submitted code, random dates/seed, injection implementation and s1b_results.txt not recovered. Revisions cannot certify those missing analyses. Literal full-raw early-code runs are ongoing.
selection: Whole-word Key; original strict price/liquidity/count rules; cutoff36.0. Full ZIP yields597 candidates,1580 controls,27 keys. Also retain recovered597/1514 cohort to separate input completeness from estimator changes. No post-outcome selection tuning.
time: Unix epoch seconds UTC, matching historical code; nominal published date, exact announcement instant not established.
additional_sensitivities: shift event date to2019-10-29; same[-21,20] offsets
zero-fill absent days only as explicitly hypothetical measurement scenario
text-date aggregation audit; fit separately if event-day membership differs
outcome: log1p(daily units); no outcome imputation in primary observed-day analysis
inference: CR1 item clustering and two-way item/date clustering for TWFE; t intervals df=min(cluster counts)-1 for two-way; normal p also recorded; full FE rank in correction. Negative cluster variance reported NaN, not truncated. Coefficients are directional descriptive contrasts, not identified causal effects.

event_study.bands: 95% pointwise item-cluster t; joint pre-lead Wald test reported, not a proof of parallel trends

containers.case_exclusion: Whole word Case among selected candidates; matches29 key-dependent cases from submitted count, reconstruction of definition because exact list not archived. No exclusions from controls.
containers.broad_exclusion: Whole words Case, Capsule or Package; broader alternative includes containers not requiring keys.

randomization.sampling: uniform calendar dates without replacement, saved before fitting
randomization.sensitivity: remove dates whose event window contains2018-03-29
randomization.tail_probabilities: raw and plus-one empirical tails; two-sided absolute around zero and double-minimum tails both recorded
randomization.limitation: historical dates overlap and are not randomized interventions;2019 cohort selection conditions on later information

injection.cohort: full ZIP whole-word corrected, primary[-21,20] window; all candidates, exclude29cases, and broad exclusion
injection.volume_allocation: Added units=grid fraction * item observed pre-window units/21 * response shape. Added units are real-valued expected units, not rounded. Only observed post item-days receive injection; no new outcome rows. For step terminal and average rates coincide; ramp/delay floor is a terminal rate, with realized cumulative added-flow fraction separately reported.

shapes_detail.distributed: per-item uniform integer onset0..20; permanent step after onset
shapes_detail.heterogeneous: per-item uniform onset0..7 and lognormal time constant median7,sigma0.6;1-exp(-(t-onset+1)/tau) after onset
shapes_detail.concentrated10pct: uniform10%of candidate items, rounded up; scale allocations so total pre-volume-weighted terminal injection equals all-item target

backgrounds.neutral: subtract observed model coefficient*treat_post from log1p units before back-transform; preserves remaining item/day/residual structure

injection.historical_disturbance: For each replication, add a coefficient disturbance drawn with replacement from the150 placebo coefficients after mean-centering. This equals adding disturbance*treat_post to the synthetic outcome and exactly refitting. This is an explicitly reconstructed empirical-noise simulation, not recovered historical injection code.
injection.recovery: injected coefficient strictly exceeds model/cohort-specific95th percentile of placebo coefficients
injection.uncertainty: Wilson95% Monte Carlo interval for500 runs;500joint bootstrap draws resampling calibration dates and simulation run indices, recomputing threshold and empirical disturbance centering. Overlapping-date dependence handled additionally by circular moving-block bootstrap of full calendar coefficient sequence with blocklength42days. No interpolation; report first qualifying grid point plus preceding-grid bracket, and >300% if grid never reaches80%.
injection.calibration_sensitivity: Exclude trade-hold-overlap dates; also compare full eligible-date calendar distribution and42-day block bootstrap. These vary calibration only, keeping event response/allocation fixed.
injection.implementation: Fixed-effect coefficient weights computed once per model/window, then applied to every synthetic outcome; mathematically identical to refitting and validated against explicit dummy OLS.
injection.precision_target: Conditional Bernoulli Monte Carlo SE<=0.01 for all p; at p=.8,SE=.008. Independent resampling draws conditional on a finite empirical background, not2500 independent historical windows.
injection.outside_window_delay: delay28: onset outside primary offsets0..20; zero in-window injection at every grid value, floor not identifiable from this window.

equal_cumulative_sensitivity.normalization: Within each repetition divide each shape allocation by its observed in-window cumulative fraction so every nonzero shape delivers grid_fraction*21*pre_daily_total units. Separate from main equal-eventual-intensity comparison; never rescale delay28.

holdout_sensitivity.definition: Disjoint actual calendar windows across sets. Calibrate q95 on earlier set; draw centered empirical evaluation disturbances from later set. Changes calibration/background period, not detector chosen by simulated success.

not_claimed: No reconstruction can verify original seed,150 dates, repetitions, allocation grid or30%/44% floors. Currency is treated as reported USD in manuscript; raw CSVs have no currency field. No data-quality audit establishes missing rows are zero trades.
amendment_reason: Additional user instructions received after first500-run revision was complete; preserve it as pilot, add precision, outside-window delay, equal-cumulative comparison, holdout calibration sensitivity, established-estimator cross-check and corrected S1b diagnostics.
knowledge_at_amendment: The original baseline, first revision H2 models, and500-run injection results were known. This is a prospective amendment for additional runs, not blind original preregistration.

additional_checks.established_panel_estimator: linearmodels7.0 PanelOLS, low_memory=True, auto_df=False,count_effects=True,debiased=True,group_debias=True; compare coefficients/covariances with independently coded absorption and explicit OLS on balanced/unbalanced toys. Same agent computational cross-check, not independent human replication.
additional_checks.temporal_dependence: Driscoll-Kraay Bartlett kernel bandwidth3 and7, fixed before these results; short42-date window limitations reported.
additional_checks.S1b_sensitivities: Historical substring keys versus whole-word keys; consecutive-calendar-day returns and observable-return denominators; three-day follow-up classified observed reversion / fully observed no reversion / censored; focal-excluded peer medians; broad container exclusion. Primary mean-price>10 and all-price outputs separated. Corrected peer categories use item prefix for Sticker/Graffiti/Pin/Patch and explicit container types.
additional_checks.S1b_scope: Full local archive corrected diagnostics; original file-set reconstruction retained separately. No H1 interrupted-time-series model invented to retroactively complete plan.
